evidence.excerpt: We release our evaluation framework and experimental results to support reproducible benchmarking and future research on reasoning-based robot manipulation.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Recent advances in frontier AI models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in visual understanding, reasoning, planning, and tool use, raising the possibility of using general-purpose AI models for robot manipulation without task-specific training.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Our results show that GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest success rate of 44%, followed by Gemini-4 Argon at 43%.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We evaluate six frontier AI models, including GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Luna, Claude Opus 5, Claude Opus 5.5, and Gemini-4 Argon, across three reasoning effort levels, resulting in 18 configurations and 1,800 evaluation episodes.
